python3 -c "
values = [366, 436, 124, 63, 153, 91, 379, 406, 269, 248, 145, 21]
print('Values:', sorted(values))
print('Count:', len(values))

# Median calculation
sorted_values = sorted(values)
n = len(sorted_values)
if n % 2 == 0:
    median = (sorted_values[n//2 - 1] + sorted_values[n//2]) / 2
else:
    median = sorted_values[n//2]
print('Median:', median)

# 1974 value
value_1974 = 21
print('1974 value:', value_1974)

# Signed deviation
deviation = value_1974 - median
print('Signed deviation:', deviation)
print('Rounded to 1 decimal:', round(deviation, 1))
"
